name: Flowers ~Kokoro no Hana~
source:
Ryusei Ryousen is a 2nd year high school student. His school has just recently been co-educated from all girls school. There are only three boys in school and a lot of wonderful girls around the hero. Which one will be chosen by the April?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两泉流星是一名高中二年级学生。他就读的学校最近刚从女子学校改为男女合校，全校只有三名男生，主人公身边却环绕着许多出色的少女。到了四月，他最终会选择谁？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
